newsitem.title: UK: BFI up 11 as Panamaxes continue to firm.
newsitem.headline: BFI up 11 as Panamaxes continue to firm.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index rose 11 points on Thursday to 1,300 points.
Brokers said Panamax rates continued firmer with reports that Continental fixed the Shinwa vessel Cielo Esta for 54,000 heavy grain USGulf to Japan for July 9/15 at $22.10 no combo.
Reports suggest that El Flamenco 69,300 dwt has been fixed for delivery Continent for a trip to the Far East at $13,000 daily although the loading area is still unclear.
Samjohn Light 73,000 dwt has been fixed by K Line for iron ore from Narvik to Cigading at $13,500 daily.
Brokers said firmer rates have also been paid in the Pacific where Beskydy 70,400 dwt has been fixed delivery spot Japan for three to five months at $10,000 daily, possibly for account of Torm Asia.
Conditions for Capers were unchanged and also for Handy-sizes with the Baltic Handy Index down one to 1,012 points.
At 1200 GMT BIFFEX was 10 to 25 points higher and turnover totalled 115 lots.
